name: Indo Credit Capital Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Indo Credit Capital Ltd is in the business of finance and investments as an NBFC[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) Indo Credit Capital is a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Financial Company. 
b) It acts as merchant bankers, advisor, registrar, share transfer agent, appraiser of projects, underwriter, portfolio management, 
broker, agent of saving schemes, deposit, etc.
c) Company is also in the business of financing lease operations, hire purchases and investing funds in properties, shares, securities, bonds, debentures, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.43 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of -1.52% over last 3 years.
